data.situation:
At twenty to three that Monday, Lin slipped on the headphones and listened to her description. She sounded fluent in the opening: her words came easily and expressed what she meant accurately. When she tried to explain why the shops had changed, she lost her place. Her tutor pulled a chair up to the table. They listened once more, this time without stopping at every mistake. Lin could hear an improvement in her fluency, although there were still ideas she could not express clearly. The tutor wrote a short note about her overall proficiency and asked which part she wanted to work on next. Maya put a partner card beside the headphones. When a new visitor asked about the group, Lin explained the Wednesday arrangements in Mandarin, then gave the same information smoothly in English. Lin was bilingual, speaking both Mandarin and English fluently. Another card advertised a British Sign Language introduction. LANGUAGE PARTNERS — SEPTEMBER
Wednesday conversation groups welcome learners at different levels. Bilingual volunteers who speak two languages fluently can help newcomers find the right table. Friday’s sign language introduction is a separate activity; please book through the library desk. Bring one question or a short recording to discuss. You do not need to speak quickly. Ask the tutor if you would like help choosing a group.

readingBlocks.zh: 那天星期一，两点四十分，林戴上耳机，听自己录下的描述。开头一段说得很流畅，用词也准确表达了她想说的意思。可一讲到商店为什么发生变化，她就接不上了。导师拉过椅子，坐到桌旁。他们又听了一遍，这次没有每遇到一处错误就停下。林听得出自己的表达流畅度有所进步，不过有些想法仍说不清。导师写下了关于她整体语言熟练程度的简短意见，问她下一步想练哪一部分。玛雅把一张学习伙伴介绍卡放在耳机旁。一位新来的读者询问交流小组的安排，林先用普通话说明周三的活动，再用英语流畅地传达了同样的信息。林是能流利使用普通话和英语的双语使用者。另一张卡介绍了英国手语入门活动。

Friday’s sign language introduction is a separate activity; please book through the library desk. Bring one question or a short recording to discuss. You do not need to speak quickly. readingBlocks.zh:
九月学习伙伴活动
周三交流小组欢迎不同水平的学习者。能流利使用两种语言的双语志愿者可以帮助新来的同学找到合适的小组。周五的手语入门是另一项活动，请通过图书馆服务台预约。带上一个问题或一段短录音来讨论即可，不必说得很快。如果不知该选哪个小组，可以向导师求助。

glossary.zh: 能流利使用两种语言的；双语的
glossary.note: bilingual形容词修饰人物；本句Lin能流利使用普通话和英语，正文展示她用两种语言流畅传达同一活动信息。本例仅选择原R00356的speaking two languages fluently义。
glossary.example: Lin was bilingual, speaking both Mandarin and English fluently.
glossary.exampleZh: 林能流利使用普通话和英语，是双语使用者。

glossary.zh: 能顺畅、轻松而准确表达的；流利的
glossary.note: fluent形容本段语言表达：用词顺畅，准确传达想说的意思。“准确”是表达意思准确，不代表照片推测已得到事实证实，也不能由这一段录音给出整体语言水平或考试分数。
glossary.example: She sounded fluent in the opening: her words came easily and expressed what she meant accurately.
glossary.exampleZh: 她开头一段说得很流畅，用词也准确传达了她想说的意思。

glossary.zh: 使用语言的流畅程度；流利度
glossary.note: 不可数名词；an improvement in fluency说明更连贯，并不只意味着说得更快。
glossary.example: Lin could hear an improvement in her fluency, although there were still ideas she could not express clearly.
glossary.exampleZh: 林听得出表达流畅度有所进步，不过有些想法仍说不清。

glossary.note: 此处是视觉语言活动；British Sign Language指英国手语，不把临时手势或所有手语当同一语言。
glossary.example: Friday’s sign language introduction is a separate activity; please book through the library desk.
glossary.exampleZh: 周五的手语入门是另一项活动，请通过图书馆服务台预约。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your recording sounds smoother, but some ideas are still hard to explain. Tell your tutor what has changed.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 听完自己的录音，你觉得比以前连贯了，可还是有意思说不清，怎样告诉导师？
acceptableAnswers: My fluency has improved, but I still cannot explain some ideas clearly.
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your opening expresses what you mean smoothly and accurately. A friend thinks this proves every claim in it is true and your English is excellent. Explain what fluent describes here.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 开头一段用词流畅、准确表达了你的意思，朋友就以为里面每个说法都是真的、你的英语也已很熟练。你会怎样说明fluent在这里评价什么？
acceptableAnswers: My opening sounds fluent because I express what I mean easily and accurately. That does not verify my claims or show my overall proficiency.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 看的是表达方式与意思传达；事实依据和整体语言水平需要其他证据。
checks: fluent说明表达顺畅且准确传达想说的意思；不拿语言流利证明事实或给整体语言水平定级。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A new student wants a partner who can communicate fluently in Mandarin and English. Describe how Lin explained the group arrangements.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 新同学想找能流利使用普通话和英语的伙伴。你会怎样介绍刚刚用两种语言说明活动安排的林？
acceptableAnswers: Lin is bilingual: she speaks Mandarin and English fluently.
checks: bilingual选能流利使用两种语言的人物义；具体语言为普通话与英语。

transferPrompt.cue: At another library, ask to join a sign language introduction and find out who can help you choose a conversation group.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 在另一家图书馆，你想报名手语入门，并问问谁能帮你选交流小组。
acceptableAnswers: Could I book the sign language introduction, and ask the tutor which conversation group would suit me?
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法
